requirements.quote:
For the purpose of this protocol, a route is defined as a unit of
   information that pairs a set of destinations with the attributes of a
   path to those destinations.  The set of destinations are systems
   whose IP addresses are contained in one IP address prefix that is
   carried in the Network Layer Reachability Information (NLRI) field of
   an UPDATE message, and the path is the information reported in the
   path attributes field of the same UPDATE message.
requirements.condition: When representing the destinations of a route in an UPDATE message.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the route destination set by one IP address prefix in the NLRI field.
requirements.why_checkable: NLRI prefix decoding can be checked against the destinations represented by each route.

requirements.quote:
For the purpose of this protocol, a route is defined as a unit of
   information that pairs a set of destinations with the attributes of a
   path to those destinations.  The set of destinations are systems
   whose IP addresses are contained in one IP address prefix that is
   carried in the Network Layer Reachability Information (NLRI) field of
   an UPDATE message, and the path is the information reported in the
   path attributes field of the same UPDATE message.
requirements.condition: When representing the path of a route advertised in an UPDATE message.
requirements.required_behavior: Associate the route with the path attributes carried in the same UPDATE message.
requirements.why_checkable: The association between decoded NLRI and the attributes of its UPDATE is observable.

requirements.quote:
Routes are advertised between BGP speakers in UPDATE messages.
   Multiple routes that have the same path attributes can be advertised
   in a single UPDATE message by including multiple prefixes in the NLRI
   field of the UPDATE message.
requirements.condition: When advertising routes between BGP speakers.
requirements.why_checkable: Outbound route advertisements can be inspected for their BGP message type.

requirements.quote:
Routes are advertised between BGP speakers in UPDATE messages.
   Multiple routes that have the same path attributes can be advertised
   in a single UPDATE message by including multiple prefixes in the NLRI
   field of the UPDATE message.
requirements.condition: When multiple routes have the same path attributes.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit advertising these routes in a single UPDATE by including multiple prefixes in its NLRI field.
requirements.why_checkable: A multi-prefix UPDATE with shared attributes can be checked for the resulting set of routes.

requirements.quote:
Routes are stored in the Routing Information Bases (RIBs): namely,
   the Adj-RIBs-In, the Loc-RIB, and the Adj-RIBs-Out, as described in
   Section 3.2.
requirements.required_behavior: Store routes in the logical Routing Information Bases: Adj-RIBs-In, Loc-RIB, and Adj-RIBs-Out, as described in Section 3.2.
requirements.why_checkable: Route storage and processing can be mapped to these logical RIB roles without requiring separate physical structures.

requirements.quote:
If a BGP speaker chooses to advertise a previously received route, it
   MAY add to, or modify, the path attributes of the route before
   advertising it to a peer.
requirements.condition: If a BGP speaker chooses to advertise a previously received route.
requirements.required_behavior: The speaker MAY add path attributes before advertising the route to a peer.
requirements.why_checkable: The received and re-advertised attribute sets can be compared; addition is permitted, not mandatory.

requirements.quote:
If a BGP speaker chooses to advertise a previously received route, it
   MAY add to, or modify, the path attributes of the route before
   advertising it to a peer.
requirements.condition: If a BGP speaker chooses to advertise a previously received route.
requirements.required_behavior: The speaker MAY modify path attributes before advertising the route to a peer.
requirements.why_checkable: The received and re-advertised attribute values can be compared; modification is permitted, not mandatory.

requirements.quote:
a) the IP prefix that expresses the destination for a previously
         advertised route can be advertised in the WITHDRAWN ROUTES
         field in the UPDATE message, thus marking the associated route
         as being no longer available for use,
requirements.condition: When withdrawing a previously advertised route using the WITHDRAWN ROUTES field.
requirements.required_behavior: Place the IP prefix expressing that route destination in the WITHDRAWN ROUTES field of an UPDATE message.
requirements.why_checkable: The withdrawal encoding can be compared with the prefix of the previously advertised route.

requirements.quote:
a) the IP prefix that expresses the destination for a previously
         advertised route can be advertised in the WITHDRAWN ROUTES
         field in the UPDATE message, thus marking the associated route
         as being no longer available for use,
requirements.condition: When an UPDATE advertises the destination prefix of a previously advertised route in WITHDRAWN ROUTES.
requirements.required_behavior: Mark the associated route as no longer available for use.
requirements.why_checkable: Route availability can be checked after processing a matching withdrawal.

requirements.quote: b) a replacement route with the same NLRI can be advertised, or
requirements.condition: When a replacement route with the same NLRI is advertised.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the previous route with that NLRI as withdrawn from service.
requirements.why_checkable: The old route can be checked for removal or replacement after a same-NLRI advertisement.

requirements.quote:
c) the BGP speaker connection can be closed, which implicitly
         removes all routes the pair of speakers had advertised to each
         other from service.
requirements.condition: When the connection between a pair of BGP speakers is closed.
requirements.required_behavior: Implicitly remove from service all routes that the speakers advertised to each other over that connection.
requirements.why_checkable: Connection closure can be correlated with invalidation of all route advertisements in both directions.

requirements.quote:
Changing the attribute(s) of a route is accomplished by advertising a
   replacement route.  The replacement route carries new (changed)
   attributes and has the same address prefix as the original route.
requirements.condition: When changing the attributes of an advertised route.
requirements.required_behavior: Advertise a replacement route to accomplish the attribute change.
requirements.why_checkable: An attribute change can be checked for a corresponding replacement advertisement.

requirements.quote:
Changing the attribute(s) of a route is accomplished by advertising a
   replacement route.  The replacement route carries new (changed)
   attributes and has the same address prefix as the original route.
requirements.condition: When advertising a replacement route to change a route attribute or attributes.
requirements.required_behavior: Carry the new, changed attributes in the replacement route.
requirements.why_checkable: The replacement advertisement attributes can be compared with the intended updated values.

requirements.quote:
Changing the attribute(s) of a route is accomplished by advertising a
   replacement route.  The replacement route carries new (changed)
   attributes and has the same address prefix as the original route.
requirements.condition: When advertising a replacement route to change a route attribute or attributes.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the same address prefix as the original route.
requirements.why_checkable: The replacement and original route prefixes can be compared for equality.
